evidence.name: Screen field: Boldness of the error text
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Boldness of the error text" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Boldness of the error text
sections.description: Sets how heavy the error message looks (for example 400 regular or 600 semibold). Regular (400) works in most cases; step up to 600 if you want the error to stand out more. Paired with the red color, a bit more weight helps users notice and correct a rejected answer so they keep moving through the funnel.
